text.tspan: Loose food includes camp, personal and journey holdings; it excludes intake, bodies and standing plants.
Lowest health includes terminal values. Original children are paired by identity; subsequent birth cohorts are unpaired.
Injury is a model dose, not net health loss or a clinical diagnosis. Daily points can miss intervening health minima.
Current-law copied-world comparison; not historical-law replay, physiological calibration or seasonal viability.
